notes.title: Release date and future content
notes.notes:
Greetings to all cubers!

[h3]Release Date[/h3]
May 23rd 2024 will be the official release date of the game! After the successful demo, which you could try for the first time during the Steam Next Fest, I haven't slowed down and am working hard to bring you the full version with new challenges. If you haven't tried the demo yet, you still have a chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703100/Kubikon_3D/
[h3]Free Updates[/h3]
Right from launch, you'll have 50 varied levels at your fingertips, and some of them will really give you a hard time. But it doesn't stop there. I plan to spoil you with free updates that will add more levels to the game. Thanks to the built-in editor, you will be able to continuously expand the list yourself!

[h3]Additional content[/h3]
And hold on to your hats, because this is just the beginning! Your Kubikon 3D adventure will be enriched with several additional packs soon after release! These will be released over the course of this year and next. Each DLC will bring new environments and most importantly, new gameplay mechanics and puzzles that are guaranteed to challenge you.

[h3]Join the Community[/h3]
Got feedback, questions, or just want to share your initial victories (or amusing defeats)? I'm all ears! Join the community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/avabBNY]Discord[/url]. Your insights make Kubikon 3D even better.

Stay cubed until next time!
Petr Kubicek aka KUBI Games
